methods.name: Isotonic regression (PAVA): fitted values, block counts, sorted x and order on tie-free x
quantities: yf (doc, doc3, ir4, mono, decr, unsorted)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n < 100: 1e-6 relative, abs 1e-12; x, ord and block counts exact

deviations.note: p2a's i_knots are 0-based block starts ([0, 2] for doc; R iKnots (2, 9), 1-based block ends) and yc is cumsum(yf) of length n (R: cumsum(c(0, y)), length n + 1). The knot counts agree on doc and decr; on ir4 R keeps two adjacent pooled blocks with the same fitted value 6 apart (iKnots 4, 5, 6, 9, 10) where p2a merges them (4 knots). The fitted values agree and are pinned.

deviations.quantity: fitted values with tied x (yf_tiedx, iknots_tiedx)
deviations.note: R orders by (x, -y) so tied x are pooled: R yf (2, 2, 3, 3, 5); p2a (1, 2.5, 2.5, 4, 5).
